keywords: trend timeline time-series growth rate continuous
use_for: Showing change over time — revenue growth DAU temperature
avoid_when: Comparing discrete unrelated categories; few data points
accessibility: aria-label for each series; tooltip on hover/tap showing exact value; axis labels readable

keywords: comparison categories discrete count vertical horizontal
use_for: Comparing quantities across discrete categories
avoid_when: Trends over continuous time (use line); many categories > 12
accessibility: aria-sort on sortable columns; pattern fill supplement for color-blind; tooltip on hover

use_for: Part-to-whole within each category across multiple groups
avoid_when: When individual values matter more than totals; too many segments
accessibility: Legend always visible; pattern texture to differentiate segments

use_for: Comparing multiple metrics across the same categories
avoid_when: Too many groups causes crowding — limit to 3-4 per cluster
accessibility: Direct labels on bars for small datasets; tooltip on hover

use_for: Showing part-to-whole when few categories (≤ 5)
avoid_when: More than 5 slices; comparing similar values; showing trends
accessibility: Always include legend with values; label slices directly when possible

use_for: Same as pie but leaves center for KPI or label
avoid_when: Same as pie — avoid with many slices
accessibility: Center text must have accessible description; keyboard navigable segments

keywords: trend fill cumulative volume time smooth
use_for: Showing volume or magnitude over time; emphasizing total
avoid_when: Comparing multiple series with overlapping fills — causes confusion
accessibility: Use transparency for overlapping areas; tooltip on hover

use_for: Showing cumulative totals over time with part breakdown
avoid_when: Negative values; hard to read individual series in stack
accessibility: Pattern fill for accessibility; interactive legend to toggle series

use_for: Showing correlation or distribution between two numeric variables
avoid_when: Categorical data; showing trends (add regression line if trend needed)
accessibility: Keyboard-navigable points; tooltip with exact values; accessible color scheme

use_for: Scatter with third dimension encoded as bubble size
avoid_when: When size differences are subtle — perception is poor
accessibility: Label bubbles or tooltip; ensure minimum bubble size for touch targets

use_for: Showing frequency distribution of a continuous variable
avoid_when: Categorical data; precise comparisons between groups
accessibility: Axis labels with bin ranges; tooltip on hover; no gaps between bars

use_for: Showing patterns across two categorical dimensions
avoid_when: When exact values matter more than patterns; small datasets
accessibility: Color scale legend; value labels in cells; accessible palette (not red/green)

use_for: Showing progressive reduction through conversion stages
avoid_when: Equal-stage data; non-sequential data
accessibility: Label each stage with count and percentage; tooltip

use_for: Showing incremental changes contributing to a total
avoid_when: Non-sequential data; too many steps > 10
accessibility: Color-encode increase/decrease with pattern supplement; legend

use_for: Showing a single KPI against a range or target
avoid_when: Multiple values comparison; precise readings needed
accessibility: aria-valuenow aria-valuemin aria-valuemax on progress element

use_for: Showing hierarchical data with size = value
avoid_when: Too many levels > 3; small segments become unreadable
accessibility: Interactive drill-down with back-path; tooltip; keyboard nav

use_for: Showing flow volume between nodes — budget allocation user journey
avoid_when: When exact values needed; too many nodes causes spaghetti
accessibility: Interactive hover highlight; tooltip per link; keyboard nav

keywords: network relationship node edge connection graph
use_for: Showing relationships connections between entities
avoid_when: Dense graphs > 50 nodes become unreadable
accessibility: Keyboard-focusable nodes; tooltip; avoid color-only distinction

use_for: Comparing profiles across multiple attributes simultaneously
avoid_when: More than 7 axes; precise value comparison
accessibility: Legend; value labels; tooltip; avoid red/green only

keywords: finance stock ohlc trading price range
use_for: Financial open-high-low-close data visualization
avoid_when: Non-financial data; beginners without context labels
accessibility: Color + shape encoding; tooltip with OHLC values; legend

use_for: Showing events or tasks over a time axis (project schedule)
avoid_when: Non-temporal data; too many overlapping events
accessibility: Group overlapping events; tooltip with details; keyboard nav

keywords: calendar activity daily frequency habit github-style
use_for: Showing activity frequency over days/weeks/months
avoid_when: Non-temporal data; fine-grained precision comparisons
accessibility: Color scale legend with labels; tooltip with date and value; keyboard nav

use_for: Showing distribution spread and outliers in data
avoid_when: General audiences unfamiliar with statistics
accessibility: Explain quartile meaning in tooltip/legend; keyboard navigable

keywords: kpi single number metric summary tile
use_for: Showing one important number with context
avoid_when: Complex relationships; requiring trend context (add sparkline)
accessibility: aria-label describing metric; visible label; units explicit

keywords: mini trend inline small compact contextual
use_for: Compact trend inline within table or card
avoid_when: Detailed analysis — use full chart with axes
accessibility: aria-label with trend description; visible but compact; no axes required
